rules.sentence: History and examination form the first steps in diagnosing primary bone cancer, and an urgent referral to a specialist center is needed for all patients with a possible diagnosis.[12][6]
Early diagnosis improves overall survival; however, delays remain common.
Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma and fibrosarcoma are aggressive malignant tumors with a generally poor prognosis.[19][20]
